description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model, and various transport mechanisms, with specific focus on function calling and WebRTC call handling.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema defining a function's name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining a set of tools, including functions like weather and restaurant recommendations.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns in conversations, used for stopping strategies.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer based on Silero models.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame for initiating LLM run in the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a pipeline execution task with parameters.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context for the language model, including messages and tools.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs context with user parameters for aggregation.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to stop user turn analysis.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Parameters for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Fetches weather data via function call.

methods.name: fetch_restaurant_recommendation
methods.description: Fetches restaurant recommendation via function call.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot.
